{{Quote|The drum corps has begun, I believe it's a percussion arrangement of 'Tialga Hath Fallen,' a traditional Alderaanian air about a warrior-queen who makes a stand against impossible odds so her children can reach safe haven. Yes, that's it indeed, and you can hear the polyphonic tones of the sequential bells substituting for Alderaanian flutes in this arrangement.|Javis Tyrr, narrating Cha Niathal's funeral|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>}}
The '''Galactic Alliance Navy Drum Corps''' was a drum corps for the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Galactic Alliance Navy]]. The Drum Corps took part in [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]]'s [[Funeral of Cha Niathal|funeral]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]; their large barges followed Niathal's casket. As the procession passed under [[Medway Avenue]]'s pedwalk, the drum corps began playing a percussion arrangement of the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] air '[[Tialga Hath Fallen]].' The [[Alderaanian flute]]s were replaced with sequential bells for the arrangement. The funeral was narrated by [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]], who identified the air played by the Drum Corps.
